what_is_fixed: official ARES angular survival is an explicit voxel exposure offset
Schechter radial survival is an explicit population-dependent offset
six positive population-specific bias amplitudes are fitted jointly

holdout_result.interpretation: The calibration is technically executable but not uniformly predictive; the Carrick reference covariate plus static selection offset is insufficient for production.

production_no_go_reasons: three of six populations degrade on spatial holdout
redshift-space RSD/FoG and model-discrepancy nuisance are absent
Carrick density is a reconstructed covariate, not an independent truth

next_required_model.name: joint_calibrated_tracer_v2
must_include: population-specific radial selection nuisance with priors
coherent RSD displacement and FoG/discrepancy term
independent survival/bias validation or posterior predictive calibration
next_required_model.stage_transition: remain at stage 4 development; do not generate final IC
